description: The language decision that routes a reply to a voice (spec #100 slice 2.5, ticket #160): the lowercased primary BCP-47 subtag (zh for zh-Hans and zh-Hant alike), or null for undecided, which callers read as English. Empty text is undecided. A zh, ja or ko answer from the statistical recognizer is trusted as it is. Otherwise CJK script decides when CJK scalars are at least 20% of the Alphabetic scalars (inclusive): any kana (U+3040..U+30FF) means ja, else any hangul (U+AC00..U+D7AF, U+1100..U+11FF, U+3130..U+318F) ko, else Han (U+4E00..U+9FFF, U+3400..U+4DBF, U+F900..U+FAFF) zh; no other ranges count as CJK, though their letters count toward the total. Otherwise a statistical answer is admitted only with at least 25 Alphabetic scalars AND a top-hypothesis confidence above 0.7. These cases pin the gates; language-agreement.json pins what the statistical answer is for natural sentences, and the cases whose outcome rests on the recognizer's own confidence (the 0.7 gate) name the measured value in their reason.
